proposition: For AegisPi's own dependency surface (hono exact 4.13.19 in apps/daemon; the authenticated same-origin console at 127.0.0.1:4310 requires CSRF protection per spec 02 §7): the csrf() text/ping hyperlink-auditing bypass (GHSA-46wx-v44x-9hh2, affects hono < 4.13.16) must be absent on the baseline snapshot (v4.13.19), and reproduces on a target snapshot inside the affected range (v4.12.24). Against our locked 4.13.19 the triage verdict for this advisory is 'unaffected' (version above every affected range); the repro pair exists to prove the oracle can separate affected snapshots from our baseline.

assertions.description: On baseline v4.13.19 the check holds: csrf() rejects a state-changing POST sent as hyperlink auditing (Content-Type: text/ping, Sec-Fetch-Dest: ping) with 403. Exit code 0 expected. Measured 2026-11-19 on locked Node 22.23.5 against an isolated hono@4.13.19 install: status 403, rejected=true, exit 0. (Also measured 2026-11-18 against the repo lock: same result.)

On target v4.12.24 (inside the affected range < 4.13.16) the same check fails: the text/ping POST bypasses csrf() and reaches the handler (exit code 1). MEASURED 2026-11-19 on locked Node 22.23.5 against an isolated hono@4.12.24 install: status 200, rejected=false, exit 1 — the 4.12.24 csrf() content-type regex matches only text/plain, so text/ping never enters the origin check at all. Reproduction: node checks/csrf-textping-check.mjs <install-dir> — the check loads hono via createRequire from the given directory, never via cwd or its own location (audit round 2 N4), and refuses to run (exit 2) unless require.resolve lands inside that directory (audit round 3 N9); honoFrom reports the real resolved module path.

resultClassRules.affected: Baseline A1 holds and target A2 holds with bound hashes — the text/ping bypass reproduces in the vulnerable snapshot (measured: it does).
resultClassRules.unaffected: Baseline A1 holds and the reviewed dependency-range comparison shows the locked hono version (4.13.19) lies above every affected range of the advisory. Scope: this advisory against this dependency only.
resultClassRules.unknown: The range comparison overlaps the locked version ambiguously, the check could not exercise csrf(), or fixture hashes do not match the recorded ones.
resultClassRules.infra_error: Download, toolchain, timeout, or environment failure prevented a trustworthy run; a failing baseline (A1 exit != 0) is infra_error, never 'affected'.
